messages:
alex_support: Urgent escalation for tenant acme-enterprises — final provisioning step failing with 503 then throttled 429s. They have a partner demo at 16:30 PT and mentioned renewal discussions next week. Adding @sara_cs @mira_am for CS handoff

sara_cs: On it. Can you paste the error payload and whether reads are impacted? Need to draft a comms plan and a demo fallback ASAP.

alex_support: Error snippets:
```
POST /v1/tenants/acme-enterprises/provision -> 503 {\"err\":\"backend_overloaded\"}
follow-ups: 429 {\"quota\":\"tenant_rate_limit\"}
```
Reads are fine; only provisioning writes failing.

mira_am: I'll prepare a short renewal reassurance note and join the call. If we can expose a read-only preview they can run the demo slides.

devin_eng: Investigating. Early signal: pool saturation + autoscaler didn't kick due to config key mismatch (scale_group vs scaling_group). I can patch and add 2 nodes. ETA 25-35m.

sara_cs: Proposed customer-facing plan (one-liner bullets): 1) Be transparent + ETA 30m, 2) Offer read-only preview link for demo flows, 3) Commit to full provisioning update within 90m and written follow-up, 4) Offer renewal prep session. Approve?

am: +1. I'll own renewal language and join demo to cover exec Qs.

alex_support: Enabling preview now:
```
/feature-flag set acme-enterprises provisioning_preview=true
```
Preview URL shared: https://preview.acme.example.com/acme-enterprises

devin_eng: Patch applied and pool scaled:
```
kubectl patch cm autoscaler -p '{"data":{"scaling_group":"prod-pool"}}'
scale deployment/gpu-pool --replicas=8
```
Monitoring health.

pager-bot: autoscaler alert resolved for gpu-pool  mitigated by devin_eng (duration 22m)

devin_eng: Provisioning retries now succeed. Verified tenant acme-enterprises completed onboarding.

alex_support: Customer confirmed preview allowed them to run demo flows; they accepted and proceeded with the partner demo. Ticket CS-ACME-2024 set to monitoring.

sara_cs: Great work. I'll send post-demo summary, renewal touch template, and an enablement checklist for avoiding quota spikes. mira, will you take the renewal invite?

mira_am: Yes, scheduling the renewal prep for next Tue. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

pager-bot: incident closed - duration 22m - owners: devin_eng, alex_support
